messages:
ollie: uploaded 4 photos  meet Marshmallow, our bathtub connoisseur. bubble-time enthusiast and part-time spreadsheet judge. :capybara: https://img.redwood.internal/ollie/marshmallow-1.jpg https://img.redwood.internal/ollie/marshmallow-2.jpg

maria: is that legitimately a capybara sitting like a person in your tub? :joy::exploding_head:

devin: this is peak content. also noting the eucalyptus towel, chef's kiss. how long have you had him?

ollie: rescued from a small-animal foster last month. he immediately rejected the crate and claimed the tub. naps + rubber duckies = bliss.

sanjay: we should petition to make Marshmallow the official mascot for the next offsite. imagine swag with his silhouette. :raised_hands:

maria: yes to merch. tiny floaty and a mini hardhat.

devin: real question: can someone bring a capybara to a conference? logistics? permits? answers needed for science. :thinking_face:

ollie: short answer: possible but paperwork-heavy. long answer: carrier, vet records, and treat bribery. plantain chips recommended.

giphy-bot: https://giphy.com/gifs/capybara-chill-3o6Mbm2Z0uK6rx1sVq — *gif posted*

maria: this cured my 3pm slump, thank you Marshmallow. :heart_eyes:

ollie: dropping one more  his "evaluating your PR" face. caption contest? https://img.redwood.internal/ollie/marshmallow-judgy.jpg

sanjay: "Rollout plan: gradual, with lots of snacks" :tada:

devin: "when the canary deploy goes rogue and you have to debug in the tub" :rofl:

ollie: also debating merch vote: plush vs sticker vs enamel pin. cast your votes in emoji! :ballot_box_with_ballot:
